study: Independent V8 implementation comparison after the user explicitly requested retry; new requests paced by 10 seconds. No resumed or replaced V7 request.
generation: Random and failure each receive exactly three scheduled generation attempts with gpt-6-astra low. Retain every acceptance, rejection and incomplete attempt. No outcome-triggered extra attempts.

budget.actual_http_attempts_tokens_and_dollars: Not bounded by logical turns. Report observed native usage and unknowns separately.

estimated_new_study_tokens.basis: Seven complete V6/V7 task runs averaged 580727.857 native total tokens; generation, Meta, repeated train/validation and final test add calls. Cache-hit and repeated input count in native total; this is not a dollar estimate.

partitions: Same authored train 2 / validation 1 / test 2 as V5-V7. Native reference and negative calibration precedes all model calls. These final test model results have never been observed.
final_test: Open only after all arm selections are frozen. Retain every baseline/arm, mark comparisons ineligible if any learning pool, formal search or complete score is missing.
infrastructure_failure: Stop on terminal failure or unknown turn. Inspect the original native turn without resubmission. This is the user-authorized independent paced retry; no automatic further independent study on failure.
analysis: Descriptive results on two authored held-out compound tasks: generation acceptance, prompt constraints, formal training gate, repair/regression where remeasured, held-out differences and per-phase native cost. Negative results are valid; no population-level significance claim. A missing learning pool or incomplete score remains ineligible.
selection_bias: All V2-V7 and component probes remain reported. This configuration reflects observed implementation and infrastructure failures, not a confirmatory replication. A prior 429 does not establish its cause. One successful availability call does not guarantee study availability; pacing does not bound SDK HTTP retries.
change_from_v7: Only call_delay_seconds=10 and the committed pacing implementation. Same model settings, tasks, seed=1, arm order, quotas, search constraints and final-test rules. No selection on new task outcomes.
